projections.note: Each parent is a code of its own book; level stays the digit count, so a letter root has none. Prefix book prefix nests by its declared widths [2, 4, 6]: 018001's kommun prefix 0180 is no code of the book, so it hangs under the longest declared prefix that is, län 01.
No book reports an issue: tree's parents all resolve, flat reads no parent cell, and every prefix code has a declared width and a declared prefix in the book.
